objective: Add a shared auth-api client and the ACCOUNT self-service feature to services/agents-ui. CLIENT-only; do NOT touch backend, .github/workflows/ci.yml, or src/router/** (consume the spec-022 FeatureRouteModule convention by adding src/features/account/routes.ts only). Follow the existing agents-ui feature pattern (src/features//{views,components,services,stores,routes.ts,types}), PrimeVue + Tailwind UI, Pinia stores, Zod validation, vitest tests. Match existing code style and antfu lint rules (all `import type` before value imports; external before relative within a group; `import type`/value sort case-insensitive; function-property method signatures in interfaces; `new TypeError` for type-guard throws; `} catch {`/`} else {` one-line brace style; `;` member delimiters in inline types; `/api/v1` literals only inside the lib client, never feature code per the 018 static guard). 1) AUTH-API CLIENT (services/agents-ui/src/lib/authApi/): a thin transport that targets the AUTH origin. Base URL = `${new RuntimeOrigins().authOrigin}/api/v1` using the existing `@/lib/runtimeOrigins` RuntimeOrigins (do NOT hardcode origins or use window.location). On web it sends `credentials: 'include'` and, for mutating methods (POST/PATCH/PUT/DELETE), the CSRF header `X-XSRF-TOKEN` read from the `XSRF-TOKEN` cookie (reuse the same approach as src/lib/vueWebCommons.ts cookieCsrfTokenSource). Never send `X-User-Id`. Provide get/post/patch/put/del helpers that JSON-encode, parse JSON responses, handle 204, and throw a typed AuthApiError (status + parsed problem-detail message) on non-2xx. Keep a clear seam so native bearer mode can later inject Authorization (accept an optional token provider but default to cookie mode). 2) ACCOUNT FEATURE (services/agents-ui/src/features/account/): Types + Zod schemas for the auth-api contracts used here: - ProfileResponse: { id: string; username: string; email: string; firstName: string; lastName: string; role: 'ADMIN'|'USER'|'READONLY'|string; totpEnabled: boolean; createdAt: string } - UpdateProfileRequest: { firstName: string; lastName: string } - ChangePasswordRequest: { currentPassword: string; newPassword: string } - TotpEnrollResponse: { secret: string; qrUri: string } - TotpVerifyRequest: { code: string } accountService.ts using the auth-api client: - getProfile(): GET /users/me -> ProfileResponse - updateProfile(body): PATCH /users/me (UpdateProfileRequest) -> ProfileResponse - changePassword(body): POST /auth/change-password (ChangePasswordRequest) -> void (204/200) - enrollTotp(): POST /totp/enroll -> TotpEnrollResponse - verifyTotp(body): POST /totp/verify (TotpVerifyRequest) -> void A Pinia store (account) holding profile + loading/error state with actions wrapping the service. Views/components (PrimeVue): AccountView.vue with sections — Profile (view + inline edit firstName/lastName via UpdateProfile), Security (Change Password form: currentPassword/newPassword/confirm with client-side validation), and TOTP (if totpEnabled show enabled state; else an Enable-TOTP flow: enroll -> show secret + render the qrUri as a QR using an existing dep or a simple to a QR data URI if one is already available, else show the otpauth URI text -> verify code form). Use Zod for form validation and surface AuthApiError messages via PrimeVue Toast/inline messages consistent with existing views. routes.ts: default FeatureRouteModule { feature: 'account', routes: [{ path: '/account', name: 'account', component: () => import('./views/AccountView.vue'), meta: { requiresAuth: true } }], navigation: [{ id: 'account', label: 'Account', to: { name: 'account' }, section: 'user', order: 90, icon: 'user', requiresAuth: true }] }. 3) TESTS (vitest): auth-api client (URL composition from RuntimeOrigins.authOrigin, CSRF header on mutations + not on GET, credentials include, AuthApiError on non-2xx, 204 handling) with mocked fetch; accountService maps endpoints correctly (mocked client); account store actions update state on success/error; AccountView renders profile and submits edit/password/TOTP flows (mount with mocked service, assert calls + validation). Do NOT put '/api/v1' literals or window.location host discovery in feature code (keep them in src/lib/authApi) so the 018 static guard stays green. Constraints: pass `pnpm --filter @extratoast/agents-ui typecheck`, `lint`, `test`, `build`. Reuse existing PrimeVue components/patterns already in the repo (inspect src/features/projects or src/features/repositories views for the established form/list/toast conventions and the vue-web-commons api usage). Do not add heavy new deps; if a QR component is needed and none exists, render the otpauth URI as selectable text plus instructions instead of adding a dependency.
verify: test -d services/agents-ui/src/lib/authApi && test -f services/agents-ui/src/features/account/routes.ts && test -f services/agents-ui/src/features/account/views/AccountView.vue && grep -qR "name: 'account'" services/agents-ui/src/features/account/routes.ts && ! grep -RnE "'/api/v1" services/agents-ui/src/features/account
